name: Gator Artificial Intelligence Camp
org: University of Florida, Center for Precollegiate Education and Training
what_you_do: A 2 week camp where you stay on campus. You learn Python basics and AI tools to solve problems and study data. You also look at how AI affects society and tour UF AI labs.
who_can_apply: Florida residents only. Rising 10th and 11th graders who are in 9th or 10th grade when they apply. Students with little or no hands-on programming experience are encouraged to apply.
pay_detail: $1,800 program cost plus $25 application fee; need based scholarships for Florida students
deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due Feb 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the CPET online portal. Send a transcript and the recommendations or prompts the page lists.
notes: Little or no coding experience is fine, per the page. Seats are limited.
